activity_summary: After Errors the boxes were opened on the baize. Pennies, half-groats, threepences, a few sixpences, and one clipped shilling Margery swears she never took. Heminges's items were a crown new gilt at three shillings, rosemary and a black pall at fourteen pence, and a looking-glass at four shillings, bought in May and not yet looked in. The galleries this week come to more than a whole house in a June week, with no June figure spoken. The hired men have their ten shillings, a wage, not a deduction from Thursday's eleven pound six. The share is forty-five shillings, the best week. James said a house that takes eleven pound of a Thursday is worth a landlord's envy, and Cuthbert steered him off the lease. Kemp said eleven pound six, and not a line of it his, and wished you would learn to empty a house. Garnish gave him no interest in the king and no principal in the jig. They fixed the king once a week, on a changing day: Tuesday next, then Thursday the sixteenth. Richard said it will be. You took the forty-five and will enter them without a jest.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took forty-five shillings and refused to jest them larger.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Said the items, the wage, the share, and the changing days, and produced no third figure.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Envied Thursday's house, and named no price.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: Steered him off the lease, and took his hand off the lid.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Read Kemp's tally, and will hang Tuesday and the sixteenth.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Called emptying a house the rarer art, and stayed out of the king.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: In the room. Her swear is in Heminges's mouth, where the count already put it.
